lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nb4Mg12 crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Mg centers show 12 geometric neighbors (10 Mg, 2 Nb), while Nb centers have 12 Mg neighbors; the periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Mg–Nb polyhedra sharing corners and faces.
